moments.evidence: La tapa d’una caixa amb pany és abaixada i es veu l’encaix del pestell a través de la cara frontal transparent.
Gira la clau dins el pany i el pestell es desplaça dins de l’encaix mentre la tapa continua abaixada.
La clau torna a ser a la mà. El pestell es veu travessant l’encaix de la tapa.

continuity.anchor: Una caixa transparent amb dos punts de frontissa i un sol pany.

Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic squirrel; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Gira la clau dins el pany i el pestell es desplaça dins de l’encaix mentre la tapa continua abaixada. attempts.prompt: Turn this three-panel photograph into a clean flat 2D color children's educational drawing with an anthropomorphic orange squirrel with a tail in a green shirt replacing the human in every panel. Retain exactly the transparent box, the shut lid and hinges, the same viewing angle all three panels, and above all clearly reproduce the real horizontal bolt mechanism visible via transparent front: same small opaque lock housing on left in all three states, clearly aligned continuous metal bolt moves RIGHT out of its housing into the rectangular slot of a vertically mounted rectangular metal strike plate. Color the bolt blue and the rectangular strike plate ochre, keep its receiving opening dark, and show distinctly that the final metal bolt tip is inside the narrow opening of the strike plate, like the reference photo. In the middle, the key is visibly inserted straight into the front-facing round keyhole and pinched between the squirrel's paw fingers, rotating about its own shaft. In last, key removed, held in hand, and bolt remains fully extended through actual keeper slot. White background, no words, no arrows, illustrations only, three equal panels.
attempts.review: La clau acciona el pany mentre el pestell blau llisca fora de la guia grisa i entra a la ranura de l’encaix groc. En treure la clau, queda encaixat i la tapa continua tancada.
